# High School Belonging Survey Exit Slip

Subject: SEL and Advisory
Grade band: 9-12
Resource type: Exit Slip
NYS framework label: NYS SEL Benchmarks and local advisory goals

## Short Description
A short anonymous or named exit slip for checking belonging, workload, and support needs.

## Alignment Note
Supports student voice, belonging, self-advocacy, and responsive advisory planning.

## Classroom Use Case
Use monthly in advisory, crew, homeroom, or academic support periods.

## Preview Content
- I feel connected at school: 1-5
- One thing helping me
- One support I could use

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
